visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses, wearing a black button-down polo shirt, stands centrally in a professional studio environment. The background is a minimalist, light-colored wall with subtle grey marble-like textures. He speaks expressively to the camera, utilizing active hand gestures and clear facial expressions to convey information. A DJI wireless microphone is clipped to the center of his shirt. (2) The scene transitions to a full-screen graphic overlay showcasing a scientific publication from the journal Nature. The text on the screen discusses a study regarding the recombinant shingles vaccine and its associated lower risk of dementia. The visual is a static image of the research paper's header and abstract section, presented clearly for the viewer to read. (3) The camera cuts back to the presenter in the studio as he continues his explanation. He uses his hands to emphasize key points, moving them in a rhythmic fashion that matches his speech. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows and highlighting the details of his face and the fabric of his black shirt. (4) A still photograph is overlayed on the screen, showing the arm of an elderly person receiving a vaccination. A gloved hand is seen holding a syringe and injecting the needle into the deltoid muscle. The background of this illustrative image is blurred, focusing entirely on the medical procedure being performed. (5) The presenter returns to the frame, continuing to talk directly to the audience. He maintains a professional yet friendly demeanor, with his eyes focused on the lens. He gestures towards the side of the screen as if referring to the previously shown data. The studio setting remains clean and uncluttered. (6) A medical photograph of a shingles rash is displayed as an overlay. The image shows a cluster of red, blistered skin typical of the varicella-zoster virus, located on a person's torso. This visual serves as a direct illustration of the medical condition being discussed by the narrator. (7) Back in the studio, the presenter elaborates on the statistical findings of the study. He uses expansive hand movements to describe the scope of the research and the populations involved. His expressions are animated, shifting between serious explanation and lighter, engaging moments to keep the viewer's attention throughout the segment. (8) An illustrative photograph of an elderly woman appears on the screen. She has short grey hair and is shown holding her head with her hands, exhibiting a distressed or painful expression. This visual representation highlights the human impact of cognitive decline or dementia, which is the secondary focus of the science news report. (9) The presenter concludes the video by summarizing the main points. He brings his hands together in front of his chest and delivers a final closing statement with a polite smile. The studio lighting remains consistent, and the video ends with the presenter still looking directly at the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 一針兩用？防皮蛇又防失智？. [Subtitle]: 說到藏在我們不知道的世界裡. (2) [Subtitle]: 其實我們自己體內也有潛伏的危機. (3) [Subtitle]: 像是失智症. (4) [Subtitle]: 但最近有一項刊登在《Nature》的大規模研究發現. (5) [Subtitle]: 打一針帶狀皰疹疫苗不止防皮蛇. (6) [Subtitle]: 還可能防失智. (7) [Subtitle]: 英美研究人員調查了超過 28 萬名老年人的健康記錄. (8) [Subtitle]: 發現打過疫苗的人未來罹患失智症的機率比沒打的低了約 20%. (9) [Slogan]: 英國疫苗策略揭開防失智新線索. [Subtitle]: 當時疫苗數量有限.
